annotations.text:
The premise: Adjent already has a logo, it just hasn't been named one.

The tray draws an arc whose sweep is utilization and whose colour is the verdict. The identity is that same drawing, held still — so the icon on the download page and the icon in the notification area are literally one shape, and every rule about it is a rule the product already follows.

Colour is reserved for meaning: the brand is monochrome, and green/amber/red never appear outside a verdict.
